My dear [Mrs Johns](/person/772),
I am very glad there is a prospect of our seeing [Miss Keary](/person/793).

Would you or [Kate](/person/887) be so kind as to let us know when she comes, and how long she is likely to be with you, and then we may fix a day for meeting or trying to meet.

Next week and the week after too we have friends coming to us just so invalidish that I dare not make engagements till I have seen how they are, and the length of the second visit also, but at any rate, I hope we shall not miss seeing you and Miss Keary

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: With envelope addressed to Mrs Johns/ Winton House/ Winchester and postmarked Winchester 9 July 1867.
